resources.string: Your everyday shopping list works offline, without an account or a server. Start with the things you need and make it your own.
You can reopen this tour from Settings at any time.
Tap the keyboard to add items, or hold the microphone to speak. Tap and hold an item to edit its name, quantity, category or shop.
Microphone and camera access are requested only when you use those features.
Scan a barcode to add a package, or share a recipe link to review its ingredients. You confirm any suggested product name.
Product lookup is optional in Settings. Enabling it sends the barcode to Open Food Facts.
Choose Start shopping and check items as you buy them. Finish shop saves checked items in History; unchecked items stay on your list.
History helps you rebuy essentials. Repeat rules add items only on the schedule you choose.
To shop together, tap the sharing icon on your list. Scan a server QR or paste its link, then sign in and approve the connection. Create a household or open an invitation to join.
Save and verify the recovery kit when creating a household. To join one, open its invitation and compare the full device fingerprint with its owner.
